# Dogs R Us Collingwood

> Dog daycare in Collingwood serving Grey County and the Georgian Bay area (including Thornbury and The Blue Mountains). Small dog daycare, big dog daycare, puppy daycare, dog walking, and dog boarding (little dogs only). Owner-operated by Tracie.

## About

Dogs R Us Collingwood offers dog daycare in Collingwood with separate small dog daycare and big dog daycare areas. Proudly serving Grey County and the Georgian Bay area, including Collingwood, Thornbury and The Blue Mountains. Big dog daycare opens August 10, 2026. Puppy daycare is available from 4 months with required vaccines. The two size groups never mix. Every dog needs a Meet & Greet and a signed waiver before daycare.

## Service area

- Collingwood
- Thornbury
- The Blue Mountains
- Grey County
- Georgian Bay area

## Services

- Dog daycare in Collingwood (small dog daycare and big dog daycare) — full day $50, half day $30 (up to 5 hrs), shoppers special $20 (up to 3 hrs); +HST
- Dog walking (little and big dogs, same rates) — 15 min $10, 30 min $15, 5-walk package $65, 10-walk package $130
- Dog boarding in Collingwood — little dogs only — $75 +HST / 24 hours (includes a full daycare day)
- Spaw treatments (by size) — teeth brushing $15; bath/brush/ears $25 little / $45 big; paw balm $10 little / $15 big; full spaw $45 little / $70 big
- Treats R Us — house-made freeze-dried single-ingredient treats; shipping available

## Booking

No online booking forms. Call or text Tracie at 705-606-4145. Documents: waiver and policy PDFs linked from the site FAQ.
